programs.source: string encode(string text) alphabet := "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/" bytes := text.codepoints() result := "" for: i < #bytes step 3 remaining := #bytes - i second := if remaining >= 2 then bytes[i + 1] else 0 third := if remaining >= 3 then bytes[i + 2] else 0 value := bytes[i] * 65536 + second * 256 + third divisors := [262144, 4096, 64, 1] for: divisor := divisors[digit] result += if digit <= remaining then alphabet[value / divisor % 64] else "=" return result inputs := ["Man", "Hello, World!", "", "bold", "a+b=c?"] for text := inputs[] encoded := encode(text) println("{DQ}{text}{DQ} -> {DQ}{encoded}{DQ}")
